task: Try not to drop the key while the door is still closed. Open the door, then pick up the box in the other room.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: Absence(key_lost) soft captures 'try not to drop the key while the door is still closed' (the preference cue makes it soft, and key_lost is exactly the event of losing the key before the door opens). Existence(target_picked_up) hard with Precedence(door_open, target_picked_up) hard captures 'open the door, then pick up the box'; the Precedence plus the hard Existence forces door_open, so no Existence(door_open) is needed, and the task never commands key acquisition.

Open the door, then pick up the target box
Open the door before picking up the target box
